Server Data

group SENSOR_SERVER_DATA

Data types and structure used by data process callback in server models.

Defines

SENSOR_SERVER_GET 0

Uses sensor_server_get_t.

SENSOR_SERVER_GET_COLUMN 1

Uses sensor_server_get_column_t.

SENSOR_SERVER_GET_SERIES 2

Uses sensor_server_get_series_t.

SENSOR_SERVER_SET_CADENCE 3

Uses sensor_server_set_cadence_t.

SENSOR_SERVER_SET_SETTING 4

Uses sensor_server_set_setting_t.

SENSOR_SERVER_COMPARE_CADENCE 5

Uses sensor_server_compare_cadence_t.

void *raw_data

Pointer to raw data to be fetched or set by user.
